    CONNECT THE PIECES

    Build it. Break it.
    Recover it.

    Three guided projects with real example files, commands, expected results and evidence milestones.

    Commands run on your own disposable machine or server. This site records your observations; it cannot independently verify external Docker, Kubernetes or cloud execution. Review the resource scope and cleanup before each project.
    ONE CITY · EXPLORE ONE TOWN AT A TIME

    Kubernetes See how it connects.

    Thirteen connected towns. Pick a town, follow its labeled arrows, then zoom into smaller features. Solid lines show network exchanges; dashed lines explain local actions and relationships. Rotate, zoom and click any component to look inside.

    Mouse: left-drag to rotate horizontally and vertically; right-drag to pan; scroll to zoom. Touch: one finger rotates, two fingers pan/zoom. The labeled buttons work without gestures. Select a tree item or search result to fly closer. The scan is illustrative, and this is a bounded DevOps teaching architecture. Logical relationships and real network exchanges are labeled separately. Use Complete city to return from one district.
